digest.component_or_area: snapshot-entry schema / fetcher / schemas drift gate
propositions: The snapshot-entry schema contract is defined in _snapshot_schema.py but is not imported or validated by the fetcher producer, leaving the contract unenforced
The snapshot schema is a hand-rolled Python module outside the schemas.load() machinery, while 90 sibling schemas are automatically validated via jsonschema and CI drift gates
A data-destroying inbound CLEAR path is gated by a parent present-vs-absent distinction in the schema that has no runtime enforcement
Real fetcher output fixtures exist in bridge_state/snapshots/ but are gitignored and contain PII, requiring a redacted tracked fixture
The snapshot-entry contract must be moved into src/rebar/schemas/ and integrated with the existing generated-types drift gate to enforce divergence on producer field changes
